title: Marie B NDE 3794
content: I was young. I met a stranger, a guy at a bar who was giving me a ride home. As we got a few blocks from my house, he slowed down to park in a dark secluded park like area to rape me I figured. I had my big purse and some books with me. As he started to slow down, I quickly threw my things out the opened door and just as I jumped out, he put his foot on the gas pedal and speeded up. I flew out the door and landed very hard in the road hitting my head hard. Instantly, I felt myself rising up into the air and gazing down below at my body. It grossed me out, as I must have been having a seizure. As I was floating above my body, I saw my body contort and my hands were like shaking and wiggling in a spastic way. I immediately felt REVULSION to that body and thought 'how grotesque'. I felt myself going higher up away from my body and I thought to myself, 'Oh no, I don't want to die now - my father and my dog need me.' At that point, I could not feel my body at all - just was viewing it from above. Slowly I felt myself 'coming down' and then I felt pins and needles in my hands and arms up to my elbows. I got up from the road and went to a house across the street and they called the police for me who then took me to the hospital even though I said I felt fine. They said I should be checked out anyway. At the hospital, the doctor took some instrument and scraped it across the bottom of my feet. He said I was unconscious at the point of impact. I insisted that no I was wide-awake. We argued back and forth. I guess my body was unconscious, but my spirit was fully awake. Years later, whenever I began to doubt the existence of the spirit after death, I would think back on this experience and believe again.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt herself rising into the air; later felt 'coming down' and pins-and-needles in hands/arms.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Jumped/fell from a moving car and hit her head on the road.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed her body seizing/contorting; strong revulsion toward the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate OBE after impact, then return without tunnel/light/life review/boundary.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Strong disgust/revulsion at seeing her body ('how grotesque') while observing seizure-like movements.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Instantly, I felt myself rising up into the air and gazing down below at my body.”; “I immediately felt REVULSION to that body and thought 'how grotesque'.”; “Oh no, I don't want to die now - my father and my dog need me.”; “I guess my body was unconscious, but my spirit was fully awake.”
